topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I can't believe it. Of all the teachers in the world, why does my child have to be stuck with the same one I had? I know every little quirk, every pet peeve, and they haven't changed. I remember how rigid they were, how little they seemed to care about anything beyond the textbook. I'm worried sick about how this might affect my kid, how it could hold them back. I need to find a way to help them navigate this, to ensure they don't end up feeling as lost and frustrated as I did. What can I do? There has to be a way to make this right.
